name: oxcode-skills
description: Skills for OxCode, maintained by Oxlo.ai and open to contributions.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Review a change for defects that would reach a user, with a reproducing input for every one.
plugins.author: Oxlo.ai

plugins.name: ui-review
plugins.description: Review an interface for what a user would actually hit: contrast, focus, overflow, empty and error states.
plugins.author: Oxlo.ai

plugins.name: triage
plugins.description: Turn logs into ranked hypotheses with distinguishing tests, without guessing root cause or treating correlation as cause.
plugins.author: Oxlo.ai

plugins.name: test-hardening
plugins.description: Prove tests actually catch defects by mutating code and observing named failures.
plugins.author: Oxlo.ai

plugins.name: refactor
plugins.description: Restructure code without changing behaviour, proven step by step against a test baseline.
plugins.author: Oxlo.ai

plugins.name: perf
plugins.description: Measure, profile, and optimise code with before-and-after numbers, without guessing or unverified claims.
plugins.author: Oxlo.ai

plugins.name: migrate
plugins.description: Upgrade dependencies and frameworks where equivalence is proven against tests, with codebase-filtered breaking changes.
plugins.author: Oxlo.ai

plugins.name: api-design
plugins.description: Review public interfaces, endpoints, and library APIs for omissions, breaking changes, and caller ergonomics.
plugins.author: Oxlo.ai
